_about: Phase 3 scorecard (5 items), added 2026-11-21 at the user's request while the embeddings were still being computed: no Phase 3 method output, metric or signal existed when this file was committed (git order shows it). Each item groups criteria from config/phase3_criteria.json and passes only if all of its criteria pass in the verifier (mdqc.verify_phase3, full mode). The scorecard checks that the phase was done correctly and independently verified; it deliberately has NO performance target, so a weak result (e.g. the FDA-term baseline winning) is reported, not hidden or tuned.

S1_honest_reference.means: codebook, sample and criteria committed before the labels; labels committed before any result and never changed; 20-label spot-check >= 16/20 agree

S2_fair_method_choice.means: method chosen on validation only; test scored once; every accuracy, interval and the comparison with the FDA-term baseline recomputed independently

S3_similar_report_search.means: BM25, embedding and hybrid search rankings and MRR recomputed with independent code

S4_signals_and_backtest.means: every early-warning signal and the recall backtest recomputed from the database with independent code

S5_database_and_ci.means: every report has exactly one failure mode in the database, matching the saved predictions and an independent re-run of the chosen method; unit tests and the offline verifier pass in CI
